mapper.select: SELECT po.*, p.product_name, p.product_code FROM production_orders po LEFT JOIN products p ON po.product_id = p.id ORDER BY po.id
SELECT po.*, p.product_name, p.product_code FROM production_orders po LEFT JOIN products p ON po.product_id = p.id WHERE po.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO production_orders (order_number, product_id, quantity, status, start_date, due_date, completed_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNumber}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{completedDate}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE production_orders SET order_number = #{orderNumber}, product_id = #{productId}, quantity = #{quantity}, status = #{status}, start_date = #{startDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed_date = #{completedDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
